subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Should native chat permanently execute model-authored Canvas documents in isolated WebViews using capability URLs and the Gateway's effective TLS identity as the trust boundary?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it creates a new cross-platform content-execution and certificate-validation boundary whose product threat model cannot be approved from tests or automated review alone.

options.title: Accept with exact-head proof
options.body: Approve the architecture after redacted live diagnostics demonstrate successful pinned loading plus pin-mismatch, redirect, oversized-document, expired-capability, and content-process failure behavior on the current head.

options.title: Pause native execution
options.body: Keep native clients on transcript-only rendering until maintainers choose a narrower document-rendering or network-isolation design.

recommendation.title: Accept with exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Approve the architecture after redacted live diagnostics demonstrate successful pinned loading plus pin-mismatch, redirect, oversized-document, expired-capability, and content-process failure behavior on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows ownership of the feature's native-client, Gateway route, and TLS design, making this the strongest available routing candidate for the boundary decision.
